description: Search every allowed pack for tools by what you want to do ("low stock", "create a product", "deploy the app"). Returns matching tool names with their pack, whether they are listed and whether they change data. Run a read-only match with call_tool and a write with call_write_tool, or enable_packs to list its pack.
